name: memory_search
description: Search the caller's append-only history (past call summaries, past bookings). Returns the top-k matching entries. History is never preloaded into the prompt; call this only when needed.

caller_id.description: Caller phone number in E.164 form, or an anonymous call id.

query.description: Natural-language search query, e.g. 'last reservation' or 'cancellation'.
